Congress Protests Rahul Gandhi's Detention in Himachal Pradesh

Congress workers in Himachal Pradesh protested the detention of Rahul Gandhi in Shimla. Telangana Chief Minister Revanth Reddy stated that the detention reflected the "hubris of a failing govt." and alleged that the BJP was afraid of Rahul Gandhi's leadership. Reddy vowed that the INDIA bloc would fight for democracy and voting rights.
